face.name: “太阳裂片”莱拉
face.text: 每当你施放一个法术，随机将一张牧师法术牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 起来吧，美丽的太阳！赶走那妒忌的敌人，他们因为你的传说卡牌美得多，已经气得面色惨白了。

face.name: Lyra the Sunshard
face.text: Whenever you cast a spell, add a random Priest spell to your hand.
face.flavorText: Arise, fair sun, and kill my envious foes. They don't have a legendary as beautiful as you.

face.name: 药剂大师普崔塞德
face.text: 在一个随从死亡后，将一份药剂置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: “好消息！各位！我现在是潜行者的牌了！”

face.name: Potionmaster Putricide
face.text: After a minion dies, add a Concoction to your hand.
face.flavorText: "Good news everyone! I'm a Rogue card now!"

face.name: 巨盾卫士阿斯维顿
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：施放你对手使用的上一张法术牌的复制。
face.flavorText: 你以为这块盾就算大了吗，那你可得看看他那块巨巨巨巨巨盾。

face.name: Asvedon, the Grandshield
face.text: Taunt Battlecry: Cast a copy of the last spell your opponent played.
face.flavorText: If you think that's strong, you should see his Great Great Grandshield.

face.name: 杰斯·织暗
face.text: 战吼： 施放你在本局对战中使用过的所有邪能法术（尽可能以敌人为目标）。
face.flavorText: 对于一个曾经的法师来说，把火焰转化成邪火相当轻松。

face.name: Jace Darkweaver
face.text: Battlecry: Cast all Fel spells you've played this game (targets enemies if possible).
face.flavorText: As a former mage, making the transition from fire to felfire was quite easy.

face.name: 莱妮莎·炎伤
face.text: 战吼：将你在本局对战中对友方随从施放过的所有法术施放在本随从身上。
face.flavorText: 纯粹魔法能量构成的饮食有利于保持身材，但会使情绪变得混乱。

face.name: Lynessa Sunsorrow
face.text: Battlecry: Cast each spell you cast on your minions this game on this one.
face.flavorText: A diet of pure magic is great for the complexion but wreaks havoc on one's mood.

local_policies: First actual shared generation/spell-history family contains all five original assigned roots,20 already executable real Concoctions and MIS_701 context,26 full original role records and52 full bilingual primary faces. Original ten-root source investigation and required next Rommath/Tess/Murozond/Headmaster/Darkvein identities remain explicit, alongside full732 past references and all six original domains. This stages genuine shared dependencies without shrinking any production inventory or goal.

Lyra follows original hand-spell CAST-start listener policy, accepts actual original cast_id and event header, requires live friendly source and original caster, then full fixed-host collectible Priest spell query with explicit class and neutral excluded. Own accepted hand attempts, including countered attempts under original listener policy, may generate before payload; opponent spells and automatic/non-hand origins do not. No hero-class substitution, paid-play side effect or executable subset. Exact official cast/notification boundaries remain local pending CN validation.

Putricide observes actual minion deaths from both controllers while the native source is live, then original GenerateFromCandidates over exactly all five real base Concoctions, unit weights. The full parent20 childIds are retained as five singles plus15 ordinary merged results, not incorrectly a20-member basic reward pool. Original hand-combination profiles merge actual physical entries, all20 effects and original metadata remain byte/semantic pinned. Death of original observer and simultaneous after-death windows follow original listener policy.

Asvedon chooses actual last completed opponent original hand-spell CAST, including countered completed hand attempts under local played-history policy. Original RecastFromHistory count1/newest and default current branch/random target policy create a new real historical CAST without paying original cost or adding a paid play/draw. A later automatic/history cast is not substituted for the original last hand play; missing opponent history is RNG-neutral.

Jace captures the complete original friendly completed hand-Fel-spell history, all cast occurrences including duplicates, using original SpellHistoryQuery outcomes=completed. RecastFromHistory draws all once in original shared random order and uses actual enemy-if-available target preference, otherwise shared legal target rules. New recasts do not enter this already frozen original prefix. It reuses original base/native spell value/branch/source and CAST/payment pipeline; hand-vs-automatic, countered histories and exact official processing order remain declared local rules.

Lynessa filters frozen original accepted target allocation: target must be a MINION controlled by that original spell caster. It never queries a later transformed, stolen, dead or reentered original target to infer former friendliness. New SpellHistoryQuery last default target_policy=any only admits friendly_minion for friendly original hand history. Existing query/default fields and all old behavior remain.

Lynessa reuses full random RecastFromHistory with last optional target_residence=None on both recast request types. The finite nondefault form requires the original causing minion as its one explicit target, no preferred fallback or multi-target override. Each accepted continuation checks original BoardPresenceReference, liveness and controller before random choice or CAST, so leaving/reentering or control loss does not retarget a substitute or consume further RNG. Actual invalid self spell target follows ordinary failed automatic CAST. Future/unknown references and unrelated shape combinations are rejected. No new Effect, payload, state ledger or second history/target executor.

Whole-card replay without Battlecry, exact Rommath use from genuine Battlecry history, Headmaster original Spellburst-cause deaths and real cat Easter egg, and Darkvein original remembered Shadow spell/actual2/1 Shade remain mandatory next work. Existing generic whole-body Battlecry profile must not be silently reused for Tess/Murozond. Full related rows and community/official evidence are retained separately; no unsupported source is registered as a blank card.

Version/hotfix/CN calibration and unconfirmed rule edges stay deferred and explicitly local. All unknown eligible content fails rather than disappearing from candidate pools. Actual internal verification is separate from formal generation eligibility and complete standard support.
